subject: Thanks!
author: CrashedAlex
body:
Thanks!

Not been here for awhile.

Yes - we were well overdue for a change.

To quote Peter Gabriel "I was feeling part of the scenery, I walked right out of the machinery."

Three Fields is up and running and we're a small but dedicated team. It's all funded from savings and we're having a go. There are eight of us. We bought the important things we needed and begged and borrowed the rest. Four of us aren't taking any salary at all. We're giving it all we've got. We furnished the office from eBay and from donations from friends and family. A sofa here and a chair there.

I think everyone thinks that all Studios are big studios, and that big games suddenly happen as if from nowhere sometimes. We're very small, but we have big ambitions.That said, it's a huge risk to take and our savings won't last for ever.

Hopefully we'll have your support!

Alex

subject: But Amazing News

Good luck Alex and your future team at Three Fields Entertainment. :)
